items.originalTitle: Lando Norris apologises to Franco Colapinto over F1 race ban comments
items.summaryEn: Reigning world champion Lando Norris has apologised to Franco Colapinto for demanding a race ban for the Alpine driver after their collision at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Colapinto caused a pile-up at the lap 36 restart by locking up into Turn 1 of the slippery Baku street circuit, eliminating himself, team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Norris.
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯就要求禁赛言论向弗朗哥·科拉平托道歉
在阿根廷车手科拉平托于巴库引发碰撞后，兰多·诺里斯收回了他要求对其实施禁赛的言论
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯已向弗朗哥·科拉平托道歉，此前在阿塞拜疆大奖赛发生碰撞后，他曾要求对这位阿尔派车手实施禁赛。
科拉平托在第36圈重新发车时，在湿滑的巴库街道赛道的1号弯锁死轮胎，引发连环相撞，导致他自己、队友皮埃尔·加斯利以及迈凯伦的诺里斯全部退赛。
事故让诺里斯非常愤怒，他认为科拉平托鲁莽的驾驶应该受到F1比赛干事严厉的处罚。
"我还没看到回放。我只是被撞出了比赛。我觉得国际汽联应该更严格一些，开始对这种行为实施禁赛，"诺里斯发泄道。
"这是人们的粗心大意。这会造成巨大的金钱损失。我所有的零件现在都进了垃圾桶。这些人应该直接被禁赛，因为这种驾驶水平不配留在一级方程式。"
当被问及在湿滑的巴库赛道上发生的事故是否存在可以减轻处罚的情况时，诺里斯补充道："在一级方程式里，我认为大家都应该预期车手会预判到各种状况。"
弗兰科·科拉平托，阿尔派，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
“抓地力会很低。轮胎温度很低，其实之前也没那么低。在一级方程式里，我们想和世界上最强的车手竞争，当发生这种事情的时候，就说明（他们）不应该出现在这里。”
“我没看到那个画面，但如果你在这样的重启中造成撞车，你至少应该被禁赛一场。”
经过两天时间的冷静反思，诺里斯现在收回了那些言论，并表示他已私下向科拉平托道歉。此前他的言论引发了进一步的网暴，而这类网络攻击一直笼罩着这位阿根廷车手的职业生涯。
诺里斯在社交媒体上发文说：“总的来说，巴库的这个周末很艰难，当然，比赛也早早地以令人失望的方式结束了。”
他还说：“比赛结束后，我给弗兰科发了一条信息，为我那些本不该说的言论道歉。”
“我本应更清楚，当时情绪高涨，但这不是借口，我错了。这些年我自己也犯过不少错误，我知道这在比赛中、在极限边缘争夺时是很常见的一部分。”
“我和弗兰科达成了很好的共识，我们仍然是好朋友，我们俩都很期待这个周末重新投入比赛。”
科拉平托为自己的“重大失误”承担了责任，这一失误也让阿尔派领队弗拉维奥·布里亚托利感到愤怒，因为它使车队失去了双车得分的机会。
detailEn: Lando Norris apologises to Franco Colapinto over F1 race ban comments
Lando Norris has taken back his comments asking for a race ban for Franco Colapinto after the Argentine caused a collision in Baku
Reigning world champion Lando Norris has apologised to Franco Colapinto for demanding a race ban for the Alpine driver after the collision at Formula 1’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Colapinto caused a pile-up at the lap 36 restart by locking up into Turn 1 of the slippery Baku street circuit, which eliminated himself, team-mate Pierre Gasly and McLaren’s Norris.
Norris was left furious by the accident, feeling Colapinto's careless driving should be punished harshly by F1's race stewards.
"I've not seen it. I just got taken out. I think the FIA should be stricter and start handing out bans for this kind of stuff," Norris vented.
"It's careless from people. It costs a lot of money. All my parts are in the bin now. People should just get banned, because that's not driving that deserves to be in Formula 1.”
When asked if there were mitigating circumstances for what happened on the slippery Baku circuit, Norris added: "In Formula 1, I think you expect drivers to anticipate things.
Franco Colapinto, Alpine, Lando Norris, McLaren, Pierre Gasly, Alpine

“Grip is going to be low. Tyre temps are low, they weren't even that low. In Formula 1, we want to be against the best drivers in the world, and when stuff like this happens, it's because [they] shouldn't be there.
"I've not seen it, but if you cause a crash in a restart like this, you should have at least a one-race ban."

With the benefit of two days to reflect on the incident, Norris has now rowed back those comments and says he has privately apologised to Colapinto, having sparked further online abuse that has shadowed the Argentinian's F1 career.
"Tough weekend overall in Baku and of course a disappointing and early end to the race," Norris posted on social media.
"After the race, I sent Franco a message apologising for the comments I made that I simply should not have said.

“I know better and emotions were running high but that is not an excuse, it was wrong of me. I've made mistakes of my own over the years and I know this is very much a part of racing and fighting on the limit.
"Me and Franco came to a good understanding, are still good friends and are both excited to get back racing this weekend."
Colapinto took responsibility for his "big mistake", which also angered Alpine chief Flavio Briatore as it cost the team a double points finish.

keyPointsEn: The incident happened at Turn 1 of the slippery Baku street circuit, when Colapinto locked up at the lap 36 restart

items.originalTitle: Flavio Briatore apologises to Lando Norris after Azerbaijan GP crash
items.summaryEn: Alpine's Flavio Briatore has publicly apologised to Lando Norris and McLaren after Franco Colapinto triggered a three-car crash that ended Norris's race at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: 布里亚托利就阿塞拜疆大奖赛撞车向兰多·诺里斯道歉。
在弗兰科·科拉平托引发阿塞拜疆大奖赛三车相撞事故后，布里亚托利向兰多·诺里斯和迈凯伦道歉。
布里亚托利，阿尔派 F1执行顾问。
阿尔派的布里亚托利就阿塞拜疆大奖赛上导致2025年F1冠军比赛提前结束的那次碰撞，公开向兰多·诺里斯和迈凯伦致歉。
这次碰撞发生在巴库的安全车重启时，弗朗哥·科拉平托在冷胎状态下进入一号弯时锁死车轮，与他的阿尔派队友皮埃尔·加斯利相撞。撞击把这位法国车手推到了诺里斯的行驶路线上，导致三辆赛车全部退出了比赛。
布里亚托利通过Instagram回应了这次撞车，声称这位阿根廷车手的操作"非常糟糕"，同时向诺里斯和迈凯伦道歉。
"我对阿塞拜疆大奖赛的结果感到失望，因为我们损失了宝贵的积分，"他写道。"我为车队和皮埃尔感到非常抱歉……我也要向兰多和迈凯伦道歉，因为我们毁了他们的比赛。
"我知道弗朗哥已经承担了全部责任，这也是他应该做的。我们现在必须向前看，确保这类事情未来不再发生。"
比赛结束后，科拉平托对这次撞车承担了全部责任。当被问及是否会与车队沟通并道歉时，这位23岁车手对天空体育F1表示："是的，当然。我想对整个车队说，不仅是对皮埃尔，这是一个巨大的失误。""所以，向皮埃尔、向一直在工厂里辛勤工作的每一个人，致以非常、非常诚挚的歉意。"
"我们损失了很多，嗯，我们本来两辆赛车都在积分区内的位置。所以，非常难过和失望。所以，是的，非常、非常抱歉。这是一个巨大的失误。就是，嗯，刹车和轮胎都是冷的。锁死了轮胎，然后完全失控。"
"所以，很不幸，我还撞掉了皮埃尔和兰多。但是，向你们两位致以深深的歉意。"
"现在的焦点转向了巴林大奖赛，该比赛将于10月2日至4日在马来西亚的雪邦国际赛道举行。"
detailEn: Flavio Briatore apologises to Lando Norris after Azerbaijan GP crash
Flavio Briatore has apologised to Lando Norris and McLaren after Franco Colapinto triggered a three-car Azerbaijan Grand Prix crash
Flavio Briatore, Executive Advisor of Alpine F1
Alpine's Flavio Briatore has publicly apologised to Lando Norris and McLaren following the collision at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix that brought the 2025 Formula 1 champion's race to an end.

The clash happened during a safety car restart in Baku when Franco Colapinto locked up on cold tyres into Turn 1 and collided with his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly. The impact pushed the Frenchman into the path of Norris, eliminating all three cars from the race.
Addressing the crash via Instagram, Briatore claimed the move by the Argentinian driver was "very poor" while issuing an apology to Norris and McLaren.

"I’m disappointed with the outcome of the Azerbaijan GP, knowing we lost valuable points," he wrote. "I feel very sorry for the team and for Pierre… My apologies also go to Lando and McLaren for ruining their race.
"I know that Franco has taken full responsibility for it, as he should. We now have to look ahead and make sure these things do not happen in the future."

Colapinto took full responsibility for the crash after the race. "Yeah, of course. I think just to all the team, not only to Pierre, it was a big mistake," the 23-year-old driver told Sky Sports F1 when asked if he would speak and apologise to the team. "So, a big, big sorry to Pierre, to everyone in the factory that has been working really hard.

"We lost a lot of, well, a position that we were with both cars in the points. So, very sad and disappointed. So, yeah, a big, big sorry. It's a big mistake. So, just, yeah, cold brakes, cold tyres. Locked up and completely out of control.
"So, unfortunately, I also took Pierre out and Lando. But, big sorry to both."
The focus now shifts to the Bahrain Grand Prix, which is being held at the Sepang International Circuit in Malaysia from 2-4 October.
keyPointsZh: 撞车发生在巴库安全车重启时，科拉平托冷胎锁死冲入一号弯，撞上队友加斯利
碰撞导致2025年F1冠军诺里斯的比赛就此结束

keyPointsEn: The clash happened during a safety car restart in Baku when Colapinto locked up on cold tyres into Turn 1 and hit his team-mate Pierre Gasly.
The collision brought the 2025 Formula 1 champion's race to an end.
Briatore serves as Executive Advisor of Alpine F1.

items.originalTitle: Horner to Ferrari rumours: What's really going on
items.summaryEn: Christian Horner's interview comments calling Ferrari the biggest brand in Formula 1 and a dream destination have fuelled speculation about a move, but sources told The Race this is not quite the case.
keyPointsZh: 该采访是在9月初意大利大奖赛之前、通过出版社为霍纳下月发行的新书做的宣传，并非他公开自荐。
霍纳与法拉利主席约翰·埃尔坎长期保持联系，2022年夏埃尔坎曾到其家中邀请他出任领队，但双方从未讨论过在马拉内罗任职的事。
霍纳此前对执教法拉利一直心存顾虑，且瓦塞尔的去留在意大利大奖赛前后再度引发传闻。
keyPointsEn: The interview was arranged through the publisher as promotion for Horner's upcoming book and took place before the Italian Grand Prix in early September.

Horner has long been in regular contact with Ferrari chairman John Elkann, who visited his house in the summer of 2022 to offer him the team principal job before it went to Vasseur, but there have been no discussions about a role at Maranello.
The interview happened when rumours resurfaced about Fred Vasseur's future at Ferrari, and Horner has long held reservations about taking the job.

items.originalTitle: Vasseur responds after Horner's 'dream' Ferrari job comments
items.summaryEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur admits the team cannot work in "perfect serenity" amid persistent speculation about his future, which was heightened by Christian Horner's comments about Formula 1's "dream" job.
detailZh: 法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔表示，克里斯蒂安·霍纳是在“找工作”，这加剧了围绕这支F1车队的令人“沮丧”的猜测。
前红牛高层克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，法拉利是唯一一支他会在不持有股权的情况下考虑重返F1的车队；天空体育F1将从周五上午起直播F1重返马来西亚的比赛，雪邦赛道将承办巴林大奖赛。
雅克·维伦纽夫在霍纳称法拉利是F1中“梦幻”车队之后，就其加盟法拉利的可能性发表了看法。
弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔承认，在关于他未来的持续猜测中，法拉利无法在“完美的安宁”中工作，而克里斯蒂安·霍纳关于F1“梦幻”职位的言论进一步加剧了这种猜测。

Frederic Vasseur admits Ferrari are not able to work in "perfect serenity" amid persistent speculation about his future, which was heightened after comments from Christian Horner about Formula 1's "dream" job.

Vasseur, who joined Ferrari as team principal from Sauber in 2023, has an overseen their return to race-winning ways this year after a poor 2025 but their world championship challenge to Mercedes has faded in recent months amid a five-race run without a podium finish.

In an interview with The Times published last week, former Red Bull team principal Horner said Ferrari were the only team he would consider returning to the pit-wall for without the ownership stake that he has been prioritising for any comeback to the sport.

Asked after Sunday's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, in which his drivers finished fourth and sixth, whether the external noise around him and the team recently was affecting them, Vasseur conceded it was frustrating.
"We are not working in perfect serenity," said Vasseur.
"For me, first, but for everybody in the team, for the media, for the 50 per cent of the questions about this. I think it's a bit of a frustrating situation.

"We are fighting for P2 in the championship. At the end of the day, we are all speaking a lot about this, and even for the guys in the garage to discuss about this, it's not the best discussion that we can have.
"But it is what it is, it's not in my hands."
Christian Horner spoke to Craig Slater when he returned to the paddock at this year's British Grand Prix.
Referencing his former Red Bull counterpart, Vasseur added: "Mr Horner is looking for a job. Everybody knows, everywhere.
"What can I do? I just try to do my best to push the team, to ask the team to be motivated, focus on what is better today, and not to spend time with gossips.
"In each interview, it will be 25 times a day."
Highlights from the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

Vasseur signed a multi-year contract extension last year and said there was no doubt about his commitment to the role as he bids to lead F1's most-famous team back to world title-winning ways for the first time since 2008.
"For sure. The sport is my life, it's my business," said the 58-year-old Vasseur. "I'm trying to do my best. For sure, I'm there to do my job. I have the best job in the world.
"It is like it is. We still have seven races to go and we will push to the last corner."

Lewis Hamilton credited the presence of Vasseur, who he worked with in junior series, as a central reason for him joining Ferrari from Mercedes in 2025. The seven-time world champion replied "yes" when asked by Sky Sports F1 after the Baku race whether the team remained on a good path forward with Vasseur at the helm.
Lewis Hamilton reflects on his Azerbaijan Grand Prix, which saw him finish sixth.
Villeneuve: Horner someone you must have under consideration

Even before he was sacked by Red Bull in July 2025, Horner had been intermittently linked with Ferrari over the years owing to the success which saw the Briton lead their rivals to eight drivers' and six constructors' world titles.
Sky Sports F1 pundit Jacques Villeneuve believes Horner's availability has to be a consideration for a team.
"Christian Horner is someone you have to take seriously and under consideration because he built up the winning Red Bull team," the 1997 world champion told Sky Sports News in Baku.
"He has a lot of very good and positive baggage, full of successes so you have to take that into consideration.
Sky Sports' Craig Slater takes a look back at Christian Horner's 20-year run as Red Bull CEO and team principal.
"I wouldn't say it's scary for who is in place, but you need to be on your toes."
Vasseur became Ferrari's fifth team principal in nine years when he was hired from the start of the 2023 season, with the current campaign his fourth in charge.
Villeneuve added: "Ferrari is not an easy place to be. We have seen so many changes - two or three years, next one, because the results don't come.
"So you are always on an ejectable seat and you have to be careful."
